title: Meganeura: Portable GPU Training and Inference through Vulkan and Metal
event_hint: Meganeura Vulkan/Metal共享训练部署编译栈
problem: 训练和部署推理通常跨越导出、转换及平台专用运行时边界，导致同一模型难以在消费级GPU上共享图语义、自动微分、内存规划和部署运行时。Meganeura探索用一个紧凑的原生编译器同时覆盖训练与推理，并以Vulkan/Metal跨厂商落地。
mechanism: Meganeura采用静态类型图、自动微分、优化器、checkpoint、内存规划器和运行时，训练阶段在优化forward图上追加反向图和梯度输出，推理阶段从同名参数checkpoint创建独立session并可应用推理融合。共享编译器把图和dispatch plan下沉到Vulkan（NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Android）或Metal（Apple），支持f32严格模式与经验证的快速算术路径；Blade提供生成的SPIR-V/Metal kernel及运行时。

evidence.claim: 在五台设备、五个工作负载、严格f32协议的50个device–workload–mode单元中，48个同时通过forward和backward正确性门；其余两个是同一个新支持AMD APU工作负载的backward参考不一致。Meganeura在20个GPU参考的最小延迟单元中赢12个，合法训练单元的中位差距为1.8×。
evidence.value: 48/50 pass both gates; 12/20 minimal-latency wins; median valid training gap 1.8×
evidence.baseline: matched PyTorch reference with independent forward/backward gates
evidence.condition: NVIDIA/AMD discrete GPUs, AMD APU, Intel iGPU and Apple M3; strict f32

evidence.claim: 在离散AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT上，五个推理工作负载中四个相对编译ROCm PyTorch的延迟比不超过1.10×，且三个训练工作负载更快；但卷积类ResNet-50仍为推理1.85×、训练2.41×。
evidence.baseline: compiled PyTorch ROCm 7.1 on RX 7900 XT
evidence.condition: strict f32 matched workloads, five inference/training cells
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 10–11, Table 6 and AMD results

evidence.claim: 每个工作负载的图构建、优化、自动微分和GPU pipeline创建在严格模式耗时0.08–1.5秒，启用cooperative variants最多2.4秒；对应torch.compile特化耗时6.5–96秒，最高差距为ROCm上的SmolLM 96秒对0.47秒。Meganeura剥离后的可执行文件约13 MiB。
evidence.value: 0.08–1.5 s strict / <=2.4 s accelerated vs 6.5–96 s torch.compile; 13 MiB binary
evidence.baseline: torch.compile specialization on supported GPU paths; package closure is much larger
evidence.condition: on-device compile/startup across the frozen device matrix
evidence.source_locator: PDF page 10, Section 5.5 Compilation and startup; artifact footprint section

evidence.claim: 在accelerated contracts下，最差训练差距为4.6×（NVIDIA ResNet-50）；AMD两台设备仍接近编译ROCm参考，RX 7900 XT四个推理单元不超过0.99×、四个合法训练单元在0.75–1.16×。
evidence.value: worst training gap 4.6×; RX 7900 XT 4/5 inference <=0.99× and valid training 0.75–1.16×
evidence.baseline: compiled vendor PyTorch with accelerated arithmetic permissions
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 10–11, accelerated results and Table 7

evidence.claim: Android XR的DinoVision案例把Meganeura训练的decoder部署到Adreno/OpenXR并共享图形队列；两块chunk在live co-tenancy时使render submissions提高18.8%、lower-eye update rate提高8.7%，median worker latency相对一块降低20.2%，但隔离测量的chunking成本随16块达到18.5%。
evidence.value: 18.8% submission gain; 8.7% update-rate gain; 20.2% worker-latency reduction; 18.5% isolated cost at 16 chunks
evidence.baseline: one-chunk live co-tenancy and isolated submission path
evidence.condition: Quest 3S OpenXR 90-second live-worn sweep; worker latency is not capture-to-photon latency
evidence.source_locator: PDF page 8, Physical Android correctness and Table 5 discussion

evaluation_context: 论文以五个匹配工作负载（SmolLM2、SmolVLA、Diffusion U-Net、ResNet-50、Whisper-tiny）和五类设备（RTX 5070、RX 7900 XT、Radeon 780M、Intel RPL-U iGPU、Apple M3）对比PyTorch，分别报告strict f32和accelerated contracts，独立验证forward与backward。Vulkan覆盖Linux/Windows/Android，Metal覆盖Apple；PyTorch在Apple/Intel为eager参考，NVIDIA/AMD离散卡使用compiled参考。另有Adreno/Quest 3S物理XR部署案例。
limitations: 五个工作负载不代表完整算子/模型覆盖；不同设备的PyTorch版本和编译状态不一致，Apple/Intel为eager参考、Intel甚至CPU fallback，比较不完全对称。一个Radeon 780M Whisper backward单元未通过5%梯度门，不能用于性能结论。Android案例未测设备端训练、PyTorch-on-Android加速、capture-to-photon或端到端相机质量；worker latency不等于显示延迟。Meganeura仍不是PyTorch/CUDA/cuDNN的完整替代，动态Python和大型生产编译器覆盖有限。
project_relevance: （项目推断）共享训练—部署编译栈可减少模型导出和跨运行时转换，13MiB运行时与秒级特化适合边缘/端侧部署；但本项目若面向GPU集群，需先区分编译启动收益与稳定吞吐收益，并在统一compiled参考、同一算术契约下补测多请求P95和跨设备内存传输。
source_notes: Primary arXiv PDF and linked artifact were fetched; evidence retains strict/accelerated and compiled/eager conditions.
Android worker latency is explicitly not treated as capture-to-photon latency.
